turns.user: my dumbbells only go up to 24kg each and bench is getting easy, should I just go to 40kg
turns.reply:
No, jumping straight to 40kg is way too big a leap and a fast track to injuring your shoulder or pec. 

Instead, try slowing down the tempo by taking 3 to 4 seconds to lower the weight. That extra time under tension makes 24kg feel significantly heavier while keeping your joints safe, though we have a few other ways to tweak it too. 💪

Are you hitting 24kg for 8 reps easily right now, or are you already pushing past 10-12 reps?

turns.user: so what do I actually do next week
turns.reply:
Stick with the 24kg dumbbells next week, but lower them under a strict 3-second control with a 1-second pause at the bottom of each rep. 


That extra time under tension forces your muscles to work harder without extra load, keeping your chest progressing safely while you're capped at 24kg. 💪
